people.name: Bahurim
people.line: Village near Jerusalem, home of Shimei, who cursed David.

people.name: Benjamin

people.name: David

people.name: Gera
people.line: Benjamite; cursed David during Absalom's rebellion; later sought forgiveness.

people.line: Benjamite who cursed David during Absalom's rebellion.

translations.web: Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite, who was of Bahurim, hurried and came down with the men of Judah to meet king David.
translations.bsb: Then Shimei son of Gera, a Benjamite from Bahurim, hurried down with the men of Judah to meet King David,
translations.kjv: And Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite, which was of Bahurim, hasted and came down with the men of Judah to meet king David.
